english.title: Vehicle - fail to send registration document to Secretary of State - purchase by trader
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a vehicle trader and the new keeper of a mechanically propelled vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), failed to notify the Secretary of State of the transfer of the vehicle to you and the date on which you became its keeper
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 24(2) of the Road Vehicles (Registration and Licensing) Regulations 2002 and section 59(1) and (2)(a) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.
